versions.changelog:
aws-cloud-architect-free v1.0.0

- Initial release of the AWS Cloud Architect Assistant (Free Edition)
- Provides basic AWS architecture design, cost-optimized stack recommendations, and read-only CLI resource inventory
- Includes MVP and Growth stage tech stack templates with estimated monthly costs
- Identifies common AWS cost pitfalls (NAT Gateway, CloudWatch Logs, unused load balancers)
- Supports only safe, read-only operations by default; destructive changes require explicit confirmation
- Advanced features (security deep-dive, migration frameworks, IaC generation) are not included in the free version
